verdict.rationale: Orama's docs describe a Faceted Search API that generates facets at search time when you set a `facets` property in the search configuration. That means the facets come back from the same query, and the docs cover filtering by category, price range, and other attributes. The GitHub README also lists Facets and Search Filters as core features. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that facets return per-value live counts, detail on range-bucket configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
